evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies NDOE as Timor-Leste's EPS sending agency.

The 9th East Timor Manufacturing Dili route is verified directly on HRD Korea: registration 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-18, announcement 2026-06-09, test 2026-06-18 through 2026-07-30, General CBT, Point System.

The 9th East Timor Manufacturing Baucau route is now verified directly on HRD Korea: registration 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-18, test announcement still undecided, test 2026-08-06 through 2026-08-07, General CBT, Point System.
HRD Korea published four East Timor General CBT skills-candidate entries on 2026-09-22; their public titles do not themselves identify site/sector, so KEP does not auto-link them.
Fishery Dili/Baucau routes are separate-sector evidence and must never populate Manufacturing exact rules.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use only current Timor-Leste Manufacturing rules for complete eligibility. Generic EPS rules are preparation guidance only until the current local notice is verified.

stages.title: 9th Point System registration
stages.action: For the verified Dili Manufacturing track, registration ran 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-18. The window is closed.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: KEP has not promoted a cycle-specific Timor-Leste 9th Manufacturing fee. Do not substitute another country or a generic HRD baseline.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only current Timor-Leste identity and anti-fraud instructions. Do not infer another country's biometric process.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The exact 9th-round Timor-Leste passport/photo/upload/payment checklist has not yet been reconstructed in KEP.

stages.title: Test announcement / admission
stages.action: For Dili Manufacturing, HRD Korea records the test announcement date as 2026-06-09.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 9th Point System Manufacturing
stages.action: For Dili Manufacturing, HRD Korea records the test period as 2026-06-18 through 2026-07-30. The route is General CBT with Point System.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: HRD Korea published four East Timor General CBT skills-candidate entries on 2026-09-22. KEP has not yet linked each generic entry to Dili/Baucau and Manufacturing/Fishery with exact artifact proof.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: Do not infer final selection from the 2026-09-22 skills-candidate entries. A current 9th Manufacturing final-result artifact must be verified first.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Timor-Leste psychology stage is asserted from verified sources. Do not copy Indonesia-specific rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only current Timor-Leste EPS medical/provider guidance. Exact provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After verified final selection, follow current Timor-Leste candidate-file instructions. Exact 9th-round documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates proceed to employer selection. Private intermediaries cannot guarantee roster priority or placement.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for selection through the official EPS system. No private intermediary can guarantee a specific Korean employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected, follow current official Timor-Leste/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Timor-Leste requirements
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa, payments and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current Timor-Leste/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact current downstream details are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow current Timor-Leste instructions only if a final health recheck is explicitly required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
